message.content:
A structured wool-cashmere blend coat, straight silhouette cut to mid-thigh length for easy movement, color slate gray with hex code #708090, heavy-density woven fabric.
A thermal-lined silk-blend blouse, relaxed fit with a slightly dropped shoulder cut to the wrist in length, color ivory white with hex code #FFFFF0, smooth sateen-finish fabric.
High-waisted ponte pants, wide-leg straight-cut silhouette falling just above the ankle, color charcoal black with hex code #36454F, stretch-jersey knit fabric.
Leather Chelsea boots, chunky tread sole design for slippery surfaces, color deep brown with hex code #4B2C20, full-grain leather material.
A thick wool blend scarf, wide rectangular cut draped loosely around the neck, color navy blue with hex code #000080, plush cashmere feel fabric.

This outfit works because the wool-cashmere coat and thermal-lined blouse provide essential warmth against the -15 °C temperature and snowfall while maintaining a professional silhouette suitable for work. The wide-leg ponte pants paired with chunky-sole Chelsea boots ensure stability on salted roads during walking without sacrificing comfort or style. Neutral dark tones like slate gray, charcoal, and navy offer a sophisticated, polished look that adheres to strict dress codes while the ivory blouse adds a necessary bright contrast to prevent looking overwhelmed by the heavy winter layers.
